idea-plugin.name: T3 Code Host (Unofficial)
idea-plugin.description:
Unofficial plugin, in active early development. Expect bugs and breaking changes between versions. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the T3 Code project.

Shows the T3 Code web UI in JetBrains IDEs. Features:

  • The T3 sidebar in the "T3 Code" tool window, and each conversation in an editor tab. The right panel of T3 opens in the "T3 Workspace" tool window, and the "Thread details" card in the "T3 Details" tool window.
  • The menu of a conversation tab has the thread actions of T3: rename, pin, settle, snooze, archive, delete, copy.
  • With a local server, one IDE window per T3 project: a new T3 project opens in a new IDE window, and the worktree of a new thread opens in a new IDE window as a Git worktree.
  • The IDE and T3 use one folder for a Git worktree: a worktree that the IDE creates is not a separate T3 project, "Create worktree" of the IDE proposes the T3 worktrees folder, and "New T3 Thread in This Worktree" starts a thread in the worktree of the window.
  • Diffs of T3 open in the IDE editor.
  • With a local server, file links open in the IDE editor, and the T3 terminal and Git actions use the IDE terminal and Git, when these plugins are installed.
  • With a local server, "Ask T3 About Selection" in the editor context menu sends the selected code to T3.
  • A status bar widget shows the state of the T3 Code server.

Local server: the plugin connects to a running T3 Code server on this machine, or starts t3 serve when no server runs. It requires the t3 CLI.

Remote server: paste a pairing link from t3 pair. The plugin does not need the t3 CLI. File links, the terminal and Git stay on the remote machine.
